page.overview:
What is Instrumental Medley?

This is a combination of the instrumental songs from Ride the Lightning, Master of Puppets, and ...And Justice for All.

During the Nowhere Else To Roam Tour they would combine "Orion", "To Live Is to Die", and "The Call of Ktulu" and form them into a medley.
